description: Test suite for parsing logcat output, including various test cases for different log formats and contents.

classes.name: LogLine
classes.description: Represents a single parsed log line with various attributes.

methods.name: test_empty
methods.description: Tests parsing of an empty or minimal log line.

methods.name: test_none
methods.description: Tests parsing of a log line with no tag and no text.

methods.name: test_trailing_blank
methods.description: Tests parsing of a log with an extra newline at the end.

methods.name: test_blank_between
methods.description: Tests parsing of a log with a blank line in the middle.

methods.name: test_preceeding_blank
methods.description: Tests parsing of a log with a newline before text.

methods.name: test_one_blank
methods.description: Tests parsing of a log with a single blank line.

methods.name: test_two_blanks
methods.description: Tests parsing of a log with two blank lines.

methods.name: test_two_lines_noblanks
methods.description: Tests parsing of two lines of text with no blank lines.

methods.name: test_chatty
methods.description: Tests parsing of a log with repeated identical messages.

methods.name: test_normal
methods.description: Tests parsing of a short, realistic log.

methods.name: check_parsing
methods.description: Helper function to parse text and compare with expected output.
